first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A is in the left foreground, holding a sword in front of the waist. The person has short dark hair and wears a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves, brown trousers, and brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, with position subject to change with the camera.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. The person has relatively short gray-brown hair and wears a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark trousers; the person does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by Person A's grip relationship and continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by Person B's grip relationship and continuous action; its designation does not change based on being at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people's feet and between the two people, with plank seams extending into the distance; it does not include the stairs above, the Pillar, or scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: A collection of disk-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered or piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual objects are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are not included.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: A thick upright columnar structural component indoors, visible at the side and in the background; defined separately from the slender, closely spaced bars of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: A background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beam racks behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: Stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps rising level by level, located behind the people and excluding ordinary floorboard seams.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: A collection of low rectangular box-shaped containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the regions visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: Orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; this does not include the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: Bright specks and short lines that briefly scatter near where the two swords meet, appearing with the sword-clashing action and then dissipating; this does not include stationary Metal Debris on the Ground or ambient Flames.
